name: table-47
description: A before-and-after settings comparison highlighting changed values.

files.content:
import { ArrowRightIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const changes = [ { setting: "Session timeout", before: "30 min", after: "15 min" }, { setting: "Password length", before: "8", after: "12" }, { setting: "Allowed domains", before: "orbit.dev", after: "orbit.dev" }, { setting: "MFA required", before: "Admins only", after: "Everyone" }, ] export default function ComparisonDiffTable() { return (
Setting Current Proposed {changes.map((c) => { const changed = c.before !== c.after return ( {c.setting} {c.before} {c.after} ) })}
) }
